About
A Based in Nigeria

What I do, in plain words.

I am a marketing and communications professional with experience in digital communications, content strategy, storytelling, and community management across industries including finance, FMCG, beauty, and lifestyle.

My work spans developing content and digital campaigns, managing brand communications across digital platforms, and increasing audience growth and engagement. I have worked on campaigns for brands including Leadway, Lush Hair, Indomie, Coca-Cola Nigeria, Malta Guinness, Cowbell Coffee, and Meristem.

FeaturedLeadwayEvent campaign2026

Leadway Lifestyle Fair 2026

Digital Campaign and Event Communications | August–October 2026

The Leadway Lifestyle Fair is a lifestyle event that brings together vendors, businesses and attendees for a shared experience of shopping, food, fashion and entertainment. The 2026 digital campaign focused on building awareness, attracting exhibitors, generating attendee registrations and growing the event’s online audience.

My contribution
  • Content planning and strategy. Contributed to campaign planning and developed content ideas to support awareness, exhibitor recruitment and attendee registrations.
  • Content creation and writing. Created content and supported copywriting.
  • Digital campaign execution. Published and managed campaign content across social media platforms, including promotional posts and registration-focused communications.
  • Community management. Engaged with prospective exhibitors and attendees, responded to enquiries and supported audience communication throughout the campaign.
  • Performance reporting. Monitored campaign performance and reported on reach, impressions, audience growth and engagement.

How I work

Four steps I repeat on every project.

Explain how you start. Who do you talk to first, and what do you ask them?

  • Interviews
  • Stakeholder mapping
  • Desk research

Explain how you turn what you learned into a plan, a framework or a process people can follow.

  • Frameworks
  • Workflows
  • Governance

Explain how you shape the message and pick the format: a report, a talk, a campaign, a story.

  • Writing
  • Presenting
  • Campaigns

Explain how you check that it worked and what you do with the answer.

  • Surveys
  • Analytics
  • Reviews
